# Pasquini Engineering, Inc.

> Full-service civil, structural, and architectural engineering and building design firm serving homeowners and contractors across California since 1990.

With 30+ years and 9,000+ projects, all plans are prepared in-house for permit. Pasquini Engineering is licensed in Arizona, California, Colorado, Connecticut, Idaho, Nevada, Oregon, Texas, and Washington, with California offices in Bakersfield, Santa Rosa, Sacramento, San Jose, Paradise, the Central Coast, Central Valley, Long Beach, and Southern California.

## Services

- [Our Services](https://pasquiniengineering.com/our-services/): Overview of civil, structural, architectural engineering, building design, construction management, planning, and surveying.
- [Building Design](https://pasquiniengineering.com/california-building-design-firm/): Building design coordinated with clients, architects, and subcontractors.
- [Civil Engineering](https://pasquiniengineering.com/california-civil-engineering-services/): Site calculations, grading, and drainage design that comply with local codes.
- [Construction Project Management](https://pasquiniengineering.com/our-services/construction-project-management/): Construction project management from permit through build.
- [Planning Services](https://pasquiniengineering.com/our-services/planning-services/): Planning, zoning, and entitlement support for residential and commercial projects.
- [Structural Engineering](https://pasquiniengineering.com/california-structural-engineering-services/): Structural design for new buildings, additions, and alterations to existing structures.
- [Surveying](https://pasquiniengineering.com/our-services/surveying/): Boundary, topographic, and construction surveys.
- [Altadena Fire Rebuilds](https://pasquiniengineering.com/altadena-civil-engineering-services/): Engineering and rebuild plan sets for Eaton Fire rebuilds.
- [Pacific Palisades Fire Rebuilds](https://pasquiniengineering.com/pacific-palisades-fire-rebuild/): Engineering and rebuild plan sets for Palisades Fire rebuilds.
